notes: Never mutate flight_id to represent recovery; every recovery copy has option_id and stable base_flight_id.
Cancellation is a flight-level option and is not an aircraft-string leg.
Aircraft/crew reassignment is represented by strings/pairings covering an option whose base flight originally belonged to another resource.
Origin/destination changes live in flight_options; passenger reaccommodation lives in passenger_itineraries.
Costs remain empty until Phase 2 coefficients are fixed.

Synthetic positioning leg for schema/cancellation-path validation.
